axioms_or_existing_commitments: complete experiential type is identified with complete structural type under common K (C1)
human-like conceptual selfhood is not required for basal experience (U3)
fixed-evaluation capability is well-defined on complete types (Paper C / R81)
derived_relations: same complete E type -> same fixed-evaluation capability
genuine fixed-evaluation capability difference -> different complete E type
for any well-defined projection F on complete types: F difference -> different complete E type
F equality -> complete E equality only when F is injective on the realized domain
same tested intelligence/behavior/report does not generally identify same complete experience
no scalar intelligence-to-experiential-richness monotonicity follows without an added bridge
prohibited_inferences: high intelligence -> more or human-like experience
experience acts as a separately removable causal input to intelligence while K is fixed
single stochastic behavior difference -> different experience type without fixed-law comparison
